B handles the font well with a bold system sans, but it keeps the gradient and drop shadow (only softened) and never addresses single-color or small-size use. A covers more of the problems that would show up in use. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers keep the mountain concept and give complete revised SVG. B handles more of the real-use problems: it removes the gradient and drop shadow, explains why, and says plainly that the mark now works in one color and at small sizes. A only softens the shadow and keeps the gradient. B's big miss is keeping Papyrus and only flagging it, where A swaps it for a robust sans stack, but B's broader fixes still give it the edge overall.
